value.note: A lantern stood in the sealed cavity behind bay 0's window.

why: A lantern stood in the sealed cavity behind the long gallery's bay-0 window, where no eye in the landing bay can see it — glass stops a line of sight in the engine's sight model — and where its light still passes the glass into bay 0. Every visible block is unchanged; one bay is lit brighter than the bay it is seen as from the slab. The refusal names a cell, both light levels and the sky they were read at. It declares no unit.
